name: Patella Baja
definition: Abnormally low position of the patella, which may be congenital or acquired after surgery, trauma or scarring and can impair knee mechanics.

investigations.principle: Lateral radiographs quantify patellar height; MRI is selected for tendon/scar pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Severe symptomatic acquired baja may require surgical reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi postoperative/alignment phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Abnormally low position of the patella, which may be congenital or acquired after surgery, trauma or scarring and can impair knee mechanics.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
